scope: Eight material polygon-attribute setters and four separately owned getters.
evidence: The five leaf routines at 0x0201a46c, 0x0201a4e4, 0x0201a55c, 0x0201a5d4, and 0x0201a64c all resolve a material by index and update the material polygon-attribute word. Their masks and shifts target light-enable bits, polygon mode, cull mode, polygon ID, and alpha respectively.

The three 0x40-byte loops at 0x0201a880, 0x0201a8c0, and 0x0201a900 iterate the model material count at +0x18 and call the corresponding per-material cull, polygon-ID, and alpha setter. Ghidra callsites include callers in ov001 and several other overlays.

All eight proposed members have exact C matches in the current match inventory. The wrappers call the leaf APIs directly; the remaining two leaf APIs are part of the same per-material polygon-attribute editing interface, though this binary has no all-material wrapper for them in the adjacent interval.

members.name: SetMaterialLightMask
members.evidence: Updates the selected material's polygon-attribute word with mask 0x0000000f.

members.name: SetMaterialPolygonMode
members.evidence: Replaces bits 4-5 of the selected material polygon-attribute word.

members.name: SetMaterialCullMode
members.evidence: Replaces bits 6-7 of the selected material polygon-attribute word; wrapper caller at 0x0201a8a8.

members.name: SetMaterialPolygonId
members.evidence: Replaces polygon-ID bits in the selected material polygon-attribute word; wrapper caller at 0x0201a8e8.

members.name: SetMaterialAlpha
members.evidence: Replaces the alpha field in the selected material polygon-attribute word; wrapper caller at 0x0201a928.

members.name: Model_SetAllMaterialCullMode_0201a880
members.evidence: Iterates the model material count at +0x18 and sets each material; Ghidra callers include ov001, ov052, and other model logic.

members.name: Model_SetAllPolygonIds_0201a8c0
members.evidence: Iterates the model material count at +0x18 and sets each material; Ghidra callers span ov001 and multiple overlays.

members.name: Model_SetAllMaterialAlpha_0201a900
members.evidence: Iterates the model material count at +0x18 and sets each material; Ghidra callers span ov001 and multiple overlays.

boundary_note: Setters and getters use the same material dictionary resolver and polygon-attribute word, but have separate owning subsections. Every listed function has a verified C implementation; the matching report recomputes completion.

related_getters.evidence: Returns the low light-enable bits from the material polygon-attribute word; callers include 0x01fff874.
Returns the polygon-mode field (bits 4-5); caller includes 0x01fff884.
Reads the polygon ID with mask 0x3f000000 and shift 24. Callers include 0x01fff864 and overlays ov007/ov019.
Reads alpha with mask 0x001f0000 and shift 16. Callers include overlays ov007/ov019/ov035.

functions.name: SetMaterialLightMask
functions.prototype: void SetMaterialLightMask(ModelResource *modelResource, u32 materialIndex, int lightMask);
functions.behavior: Replaces the selected material light-enable bits in its polygon-attribute word.
functions.evidence: Ghidra target body resolves the material by model and index, then replaces the low four bits at material data +0x0c.
functions.uncertainty: The supported light bit mask follows the SDK field definition; caller intent is not inferred.

functions.name: SetMaterialPolygonMode
functions.prototype: void SetMaterialPolygonMode(ModelResource *modelResource, u32 materialIndex, int polygonMode);
functions.behavior: Replaces the selected material polygon-mode field.
functions.evidence: Target code resolves material data and updates polygon-attribute bits 4-5.
functions.uncertainty: The mode meaning is an SDK enum; this signature records it as an integer.

functions.name: SetMaterialCullMode
functions.prototype: void SetMaterialCullMode(ModelResource *modelResource, u32 materialIndex, int cullMode);
functions.behavior: Replaces the selected material cull-mode field.
functions.evidence: Target code resolves material data and updates polygon-attribute bits 6-7; all-material wrapper at 0x0201a880 calls this function.
functions.uncertainty: Cull mode is recorded as an integer because the project has no shared SDK enum definition.

functions.name: Model_SetAllMaterialCullMode
functions.behavior: Applies one cull mode to each material in the model.
functions.evidence: Target iterates the byte material count at model +0x18 and calls 0x0201a55c for each index.
functions.uncertainty: Cull mode is recorded as an integer SDK enum.

functions.name: GetMaterialLightMask
functions.behavior: Returns the selected material light-enable bits.
functions.evidence: Target resolves material data and extracts the low four bits from polygon attributes at +0x0c.
functions.uncertainty: The getter assumes a valid model and material index, matching target behavior.

functions.name: GetMaterialPolygonMode
functions.behavior: Returns the selected material polygon-mode field.
functions.evidence: Target resolves material data and extracts polygon-attribute bits 4-5.
functions.uncertainty: The getter assumes a valid model and material index, matching target behavior.

functions.name: GetMaterialPolygonId
functions.behavior: Returns the selected material polygon ID.
functions.evidence: Target resolves material data and extracts mask 0x3f000000 shifted by 24.
functions.uncertainty: The getter assumes a valid model and material index, matching target behavior.

functions.name: GetMaterialAlpha
functions.behavior: Returns the selected material alpha field.
functions.evidence: Target resolves material data and extracts mask 0x001f0000 shifted by 16.
functions.uncertainty: The getter assumes a valid model and material index, matching target behavior.
